        <script><![CDATA[var MSS_Collateral_Symphony_Integration = Class.create();
MSS_Collateral_Symphony_Integration.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    updateTaskDetails: function(colsysid) {
        var flag = false;
        try {
            // Fetch Task Record by sys_id
            var grTask = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_coll_0_collateral_task_table');
            if (grTask.get(colsysid)) {
                // Get sys_id of corresponding Case Record from reference field
                var caseSysId = grTask.collateral_case_id.toString();
                var grBaseTask = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_coll_0_collateral_task_table');
                grBaseTask.addQuery('collateral_case_id', caseSysId);
                grBaseTask.addQuery('collateral_task_type', 'Base Task');
                grBaseTask.query();

                if (grBaseTask.next()) {

                    var fieldsToCopy = [
                        // Header Data
                        'u_message_id', 'u_source', 'u_event_type', 'event_status', 'event_date_time', 'u_object_type',
                        'movement_origin', 'movement_id', 'u_objectversion',

                        // Additional Attributes
                        'instrument_class', 'settlement_date', 'direction', 'stp_status', 'movement_type', 'agreement_name',

                        // Payload Data
                        'managing_location', 'client_type_indicator', 'hpn_type', 'currency_cutoff_time', 'time_zone',
                        'u_3rd_triparty', 'custodian_name', 'asm_enable', 'currency', 'instrument_id', 'triparty_instrument_id',
                        'position_type', 'notional', 'margin_type', 'stp_details', 'csa_type', 'product_field', 'activity_sub_type',

                        // Additional Fields
                        'activity', 'agreement_id', 'agreement_type', 'business_line', 'counterpary_legal_name', 'created_by',
                        'created_timestamp', 'miss_cutoff', 'instrument_type', 'place_of_settlement', 'position',
                        'settlement_system', 'trade_date',

                        // Conditional Fields
                        'stp_acronym', 'dealing_position_account', 'stp_enable', 'u_assignment_team', 'rule_category' //, 'u_outcome'
                    ];

                    // Copy fields from Case to Task
                    fieldsToCopy.forEach(function(field) {
                        if (grTask.isValidField(field) && grBaseTask.isValidField(field)) {
                            grTask[field] = grBaseTask[field];
                        }
                    });

                    // Update Task Record
                    grTask.update();
                    flag = true;
                }

                // List of fields to copy from Case to Task
            }
            return flag;
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info('Script Include - MSS_Collateral_Utils:- updateTaskDetails error: ' + e.message);
            return false;
        }
    },

	callXmattersForSymphonyFailure: function(symphonysysid) {
        try {
			var grSymphony = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_sw_hsbc_outbound_symphony_message_log');
			if (grSymphony.get(symphonysysid)){
				var colCaseID = grSymphony.servicenow_task_id.collateral_case_id.number.toString();
				var colTaskID = grSymphony.servicenow_task_id.number.toString();
				var errorCode = grSymphony.response_code.toString();
				var errorResponse = grSymphony.response_message.toString();
				var timeStamp = grSymphony.sys_updated_on.toString();

				var alertDesc = "Collateral - Symphony Integration Failure Alert:\n\nCollateral Case ID: "+colCaseID+"\nCollateral Task ID: "+colTaskID+"\nError Code: "+errorCode+"\nError Response: "+errorResponse+"\nTime Stamp: "+timeStamp;

				var createEventForSymphonyIntegrationFailure = new x_hsb11_mss_coll_0.MSS_Collateral_XMatter_ITID_WidgetFailureHandler().createITIDEvent('WARNING', alertDesc, 'Symphony_Failure');
			}    
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info('Script Include - MSS_Collateral_Symphony_Integration:- callXmattersForSymphonyFailure error: ' + e.message);
        }
    },

    type: 'MSS_Collateral_Symphony_Integration'
};]]></script>
